info.title: RouteMate ELD Open API
info.description:
The RouteMate APIs are secured with HTTPS, ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of your data. All API responses are returned in a structured JSON format, allowing easy integration. In the following sections, you'll find detailed instructions on how to access the API, make authorized requests and generate API key. We version our APIs to ensure compatibility as we make improvements. Any significant changes that affect request formats or parameters will be introduced in new versions.

API key

To make an API request to RouteMate, you'll need an API key for authentication. Follow these steps to obtain an API key: 1. Go to the Admin section of your RouteMate Dashboard. 2. Open API section. 3. Click Add an API Key. 4. You can restrict the API key to be read-only.

Start Building

You’re now ready to start interacting with the RouteMate APIs! Be sure to check out the endpoint-specific documentation for more details on how to get the most out of our platform.

get.description:
This endpoint fetches camera safety events for all vehicles in the requested time range, newest first by default.

Only events confirmed by review are returned, so an event may appear some time after it occurred. The range cannot exceed six months per request and filters on the event's date field.

Speed is reported in miles per hour and odometer in miles. G-force is not captured by the cameras and is not part of the response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Current page number

parameters.name: elements
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page, at most 3000

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in milliseconds (UTC time)

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in milliseconds (UTC time)

parameters.name: asc
parameters.description: Sort events by time ascending. Defaults to false, newest first

parameters.name: vehicleId
parameters.description: Restrict the results to a single vehicle. All accessible vehicles when omitted

get.description:
This endpoint fetches camera location pings for all active company vehicles in the requested time range, newest first by default.

Pass a narrow range to sweep current positions, or a wider one to read history. Supply vehicleId to restrict the sweep to a single vehicle. The range cannot exceed six months per request.

Speed is reported in miles per hour and odometer in miles.

parameters.description: Current page number

parameters.name: elements
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page, at most 3000

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in milliseconds (UTC time)

parameters.name: asc
parameters.description: Sort pings by time ascending. Defaults to false, newest first

parameters.name: vehicleId
parameters.description: Restrict the sweep to a single vehicle. All accessible vehicles when omitted

cameraType.description: Model of camera installed in the vehicle
